plugins.name: playbook-hooks
plugins.description: The hooks of the multi-agent playbook: context guard (context notices per agent, a stop that holds, the 270 s wait cap), Bash guard, reminder after a compaction, compaction log. Active only in projects that opt in with a config file.

plugins.name: self-compact
plugins.description: Lets Claude compact its own context (a real /compact: the chat history stays visible), carry text verbatim across it and resume itself
